title: Sampling, quantisation and the Nyquist limit
description: Audio as samples x[n]=s(n/fs), aliasing and the Nyquist frequency, bit depth and the 6 dB per bit rule.

title: Framing, windowing and the STFT
description: DFT bins and resolution, frames and hop, the Hann window and leakage, and the short-time Fourier transform as a (frames, bins) matrix.

title: The mel scale and mel filterbank
description: Power and log spectrograms, the mel warping of frequency, triangular filterbanks as a matrix and log-mel features.

title: MFCCs, the DCT and delta features
description: The orthonormal DCT-II as a decorrelating basis, cepstral truncation, MFCC pipeline and delta coefficients.

title: Audio classification and evaluation
description: Clip-level features, k-NN on MFCC statistics, CNNs on log-mel images, confusion matrices, per-class recall and macro F1.

title: SpecAugment and audio data augmentation
description: Time and frequency masking of spectrograms, mixup and waveform augmentations, and which transformations preserve the label.

title: CTC alignment, loss and decoding
description: Blank-augmented alignments, the forward algorithm for the CTC probability, the loss, greedy collapse decoding and why it is not the best labelling.

title: ASR architectures: RNN-T, attention encoder-decoders and Whisper
description: How transducers, attention models and Whisper handle the alignment problem, with sequence lengths, trade-offs and the 30 s window.

title: Word error rate and edit distance
description: Levenshtein dynamic programming, substitutions/deletions/insertions, WER, CER and normalisation.

title: Text-to-speech: acoustic model and vocoder
description: The TTS pipeline from text to mel to waveform, duration prediction, neural vocoders and mel inversion.

title: Phase reconstruction with Griffin-Lim
description: Inverse STFT by weighted overlap-add, consistency of spectrograms, alternating projections and spectral convergence.

title: Voice cloning risks and speech evaluation (MOS)
description: Speaker conditioning, consent and watermarking, deepfake risk, mean opinion score with confidence intervals and automatic proxies.
